form:FormGroup.label: Node Group Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: The name of this node group. It cannot be changed here.
Untick to stop all processing for processor profiles that use this node group.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: When unticked, profiles using this group do no processing.

form:FormGroup.label: Node Inclusion Behaviour
form:FormGroup.helpText: Include Selected puts only the ticked nodes in the group. Exclude Selected puts every node except the ticked ones in the group.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Include or exclude the ticked nodes.

form:FormGroup.label: Nodes
form:FormGroup.helpText: Tick the nodes to include in or exclude from this group, depending on Node Inclusion Behaviour.
